# Evans Ademilua

> Evans Ademilua is a full stack developer and web developer and the CEO of Large Technologies, based in Lagos, Nigeria. He is also known as Olufemi Evans Ademilua, Olufemi Ademilua and Evans Large. He builds websites, web apps, booking systems, client portals, internal dashboards, workflow automation and AI features for businesses. Top Rated on Upwork with eight 5-star client reviews.

- [Video editor](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-editor/): Cut, add auto captions, text, music and filters, then export an MP4. Works on your phone.
- [QR code generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/qr-code-generator/): Links, text, WiFi, WhatsApp, email, phone, SMS, location and contact cards. Add a logo and colors.

- [WiFi QR code generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/wifi-qr-code-generator/): Let guests join your network with one scan. Print a clean sign for your wall.
- [Color picker](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/color-picker/): Pick a color, copy HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK, pull a palette from a photo, check contrast.
- [Currency calculator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/currency-calculator/): Convert between about 160 currencies with live reference rates, a margin option and a pinned table.
- [Image converter and compressor](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/image-converter/): Convert HEIC, PNG, WebP, AVIF and more to JPG, PNG or WebP. Shrink images in batches.

- [PDF converter](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/pdf-converter/): Turn Word, Excel, PowerPoint, images and text into PDF, or PDF into JPG, Word, Excel and more. Merge, split and compress.
- [Receipt generator](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/receipt-generator/): 25 receipt designs, from till roll to Christmas, Eid and Independence Day. PDF, PNG or print.
- [Screen recorder](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/screen-recorder/): Record your screen, a window or a tab with sound and a webcam circle. Save WebM or MP4.
- [Video converter](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-converter/): Video to anything and anything to video: MP4, WebM, MOV, MKV, MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG and GIF, or turn a song into a video.
- [Video trimmer](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/video-trimmer/): Cut a video in seconds without re-encoding. Keep a selection or split it into two parts.
- [Watermark maker](https://evansademilua.vercel.app/tools/watermark-maker/): Add a text or logo watermark to one or many photos. Tile it or place it, then download a ZIP.
